and at last, still talking along, he reached over and kissed Aunt Sally right on the mouth, and then settled back again in his chair comfortable, and was going on talking; but she jumped up and wiped it off with the back of her hand, and says:", "sha256": "49c76088a57b32700f423196bc8e5ea0bf79b6e82adb0d1ab5f85c21a14454b0", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[40]", "source_html": "Well, he run on, and on, and on, making up stuff about Hicksville and everybody in it he could invent, and I getting a little nervious, and wondering how this was going to help me out of my scrape; and at last, still talking along, he reached over and kissed Aunt Sally right on the mouth, and then settled back again in his chair comfortable, and was going on talking; but she jumped up and wiped it off with the back of her hand, and says:"}, {"id": "043-036-0041", "tag": "p", "text": "“You owdacious puppy!”", "sha256": "c78ab214293dbd7fc9ddbc81b58b56ca529ac8cfffbbf840a715a4c452f549c7", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[41]", "source_html": "“You owdacious puppy!”"}, {"id": "043-036-0042", "tag": "p", "text": "He looked kind of hurt, and says:", "sha256": "cbc780ec6ef457443828fcd0a92ee0aa4fb6db0385b7eac8b911021f7761644c", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[42]", "source_html": "He looked kind of hurt, and says:"}, {"id": "043-036-0043", "tag": "p", "text": "“I’m surprised at you, m’am.”", "sha256": "b9442df105caf95d2b905a6d578a14782074024d87f7783b6ae81e11eb757ff2", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[43]", "source_html": "“I’m surprised at you, m’am.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0044", "tag": "p", "text": "“You’re s’rp—Why, what do you reckon I am? I—I—thought you’d like it.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0047", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, you born fool!” She took up the spinning stick, and it looked like it was all she could do to keep from giving him a crack with it. “What made you think I’d like it?”", "sha256": "b484ba02d77023bf9b4e47e63c391d3c0d566377992e76ee07ccefc85c2c6294", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[47]", "source_html": "“Why, you born fool!” She took up the spinning stick, and it looked like it was all she could do to keep from giving him a crack with it. “What made you think I’d like it?”"}, {"id": "043-036-0048", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, I don’t know. Well, I sh’d reckon you won’t!”"}, {"id": "043-036-0056", "tag": "p", "text": "“No’m, I’m honest about it; I won’t ever do it again—till you ask me.”", "sha256": "adaa1171ea9b132082f8a8f25f5b1934ac6ce90b230160242b41c2102925637a", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[56]", "source_html": "“No’m, I’m honest about it; I won’t ever do it again—till you ask me.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0057", "tag": "p", "text": "“Till I ask you! У меня есть хорошая идея взять и… Слыши, что ты имеешь в виду, целуя меня?»", "source_sha256": "2eaf09e77be076255bf83f1c127ada93a2fe15b07ba8cd815a90ee3eae6efc24", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0044", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "79f03dfc205eee27ec547d4e87ebee1830bcb22bf6806756ec0e710a939d5f91"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0045", "target": "Он выглядел довольно скромно и сказал:", "source_sha256": "535f283e7e5bc0c9c97b99ef5a433b08093cae1468d61ac8489812aad465c267", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0045", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e54cb772dcde885aa468afdc786ea3dc3e5916bae4d5e7f9234f85699669f789"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0046", "target": "«Я ничего не имел в виду, мэм. Я не хотел никому навредить. Я… я… подумал, что вам это понравится».", "source_sha256": "b3bb322bbd04602b04fa3002ef4e47ffee1df41172fdd02e026c05820e35b2c0", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0046", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1529542b5ba7337edb073f952c6c93d518c36529805f7d5e204012cd82def69b"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0047", "target": "«Да ты же прирождённый дурак!» Она взяла прялку, и казалось, что ей с трудом удалось удержаться, чтобы не дать ему по голове этой палкой. «С чего ты взял, что мне это понравится?»", "source_sha256": "b484ba02d77023bf9b4e47e63c391d3c0d566377992e76ee07ccefc85c2c6294", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0047", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "2ce47ff84694b981ecf69a17f355de31a334bfaf04b5ee143cf6314129704ad3"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0048", "target": "«Ну, я не знаю. Просто они… они… сказали мне, что ты это сделаешь».", "source_sha256": "406f0392de350b3798734180aaf0cd952bc132cddd1ecf6eecbb3873ab4fb02c", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0048", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "68843a3dad6dc83693c631b88f2b152d46084a2dbeb6be90da3ddb949b37d547"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0049", "target": "«Тебе сказали, что я так и сделаю. Кто эти „они“?»", "source_sha256": "6e5beb6d19cac21da7c55f277320b68b8aa9fac088d7fd3a10c2feb673511048", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0049", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "46c6a2059ff25b105a22d34c6628373f7d74cc06c7898a4092c5c315ae761e65"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0050", "target": "«Да что вы, все. Все так и сказали, мэм».", "source_sha256": "67e0551dd54377bf9ad671b464426b16f16026e85ed49f06f4ac376043b0aaef", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0050", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d54bbb5c401bd8ec907a87234baaa882cd241849a123dd2592433b32232ad59c"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0051", "target": "Она с трудом сдерживалась; её глаза сверкали, а пальцы шевелились, словно она хотела поцарапать его; и она говорит:", "source_sha256": "a4883e34b4c4cdaa1df76d7dcdf86ef7583c029616e014146cef2276dcf89e27", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0051", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "efa717664aca56f4aba615ea9e645773aa969754e52010d95ced507a8e4f2a71"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0052", "target": "«Кто такие „все“? Называйте имена, а то кто-то из идиотов пропадет».", "source_sha256": "860fb637eebd30652ae2b78ccd2a32f0c42a2e1337c1c75e52951997d1952ee2", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0052", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1f5342129dda2349a1ebbcd25bba5419110baea241f87c076b1e11337eeeeab5"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0053", "target": "Он встал, выглядел озабоченным, нервно поправлял шляпу и сказал:", "source_sha256": "8f002edd8a57369d5cf3ecd904a875a92d530a17128c39fede6e8ab05c6bb8ce", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0053", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "b89ef77fa22755c95d033224ab475f5d978c7e4445c55507d268da2566b78e70"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0054", "target": "«Простите, я не ожидал этого. Но простите, мэм, я больше так не буду — честно, не буду».", "source_sha256": "50e65c9e8dac490eb3d2d9e216d0dedeb9d898908bb1eb50606bd694a2844fb6", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0054", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a2cbf7053cd60d8e5638b70af2c27006f248a6c64edd8ff2e5df05122b9c9c03"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0055", "target": "«Ты же не будешь, правда? Ну, я за всю свою жизнь такого еще не видел!
